scenarios.prompt: Make a personal notes app with titles, multiline notes, categories, search, add/edit forms, and a details page for each note.
Create a personal calendar for my events with title, start time, notes, and a Category choice of Personal or Work. Include monthly calendar with daily agenda and add/edit screens.
Make an events calendar with a monthly calendar and selected-day agenda, event titles, date and time, notes, and add/edit screens.

Create a personal activity dashboard. Log a title, timestamp, numeric minutes, a Category choice, and multiline notes through reachable add/edit forms. Show a checklist of entries, a metric summing minutes with target 150, and a daily line chart summing minutes over the most recent 14 days. Include entry details. No reminders.

Create a personal photo journal with title, private photo, moment timestamp, caption, rating and favorite fields. Use a two-step add/edit form: first title, photo and moment timestamp; then multiline caption, rating and favorite. Include image cards, a gallery and linked entry details. No reminders.

scenarios.prompt: Build shared volunteer shift signups using the group capacity signup policy. Each shift has a title, required start timestamp and preparation notes. Expose shift list, capacity summary, reachable add/edit form, set-capacity, join and cancel-signup controls. Use one capacity pool per shift and an AppNest inbox reminder for active claimants one hour before the start.
I want a simple personal task reminder app with optional due dates and independent reminder times, Open and Done states, and owner inbox reminders only for open tasks. Let me add and edit tasks.
Build my focus app with a digital local clock showing seconds and a 25-minute countdown timer. It needs no notes, tasks, or record collections.
